releases.name: LLocalMind v0.3.2 - Black and green dark mode
releases.body:
LLocalMind 0.3.2 - Black and green dark mode.

- New Settings → Appearance checkbox: pure #000000 background, dark-green sidebar, light text and green accents.
- The saved appearance applies without reloading the inference engine or changing language. It combines with Italian Interface, preserving its tricolour border and controls.
- Icons and Markdown links are recoloured for dark backgrounds; input fields, menus, notices, dialogs and response metrics use matching contrast.
- Settings content scrolls on smaller displays while Save/Cancel and update controls stay accessible.
- Existing light/Italian themes, inference, Tavily .env, web profiles and resilient updates are retained. Tests verify persistence, session/draft preservation, readable link formats and restoration of light mode; screenshots were inspected.

Download the Setup EXE, or extract the entire portable ZIP. Models remain external. Existing chats, settings and .env survive updates. This build is unsigned.

releases.name: LLocalMind v0.3.1 - Faster web preparation
releases.body:
LLocalMind 0.3.1 - Faster web preparation.

- New Fast web profile (default): at most two 450-character excerpts. Full preserves three 900-character excerpts and remains selectable in Settings without a model reload. Shorter excerpts can omit details.
- Tavily still receives one basic API call per search, without remote answer generation or source-page downloads. No new query cache or paid/advanced fallback is used.
- Citation metadata no longer triggers serial DNS resolution. Static URL checks remain; actual HTTP fetch/redirect paths retain DNS and public-address validation.
- Response metrics now separate web lookup time and model prefill, and record source count/profile. First-token time includes web lookup and input preparation; decode tok/s remains model-only. Old saved metrics are unchanged.
- Component tests cover excerpt budgets, one basic request, DNS policy, settings identity and timing accounting. No unmeasured target-PC speedup is claimed.
- llama.cpp default, optional mmproj, experimental native engine, Tavily .env, languages/themes and resilient updates are retained.

Download the Setup EXE, or extract the entire portable ZIP. Models remain external. Existing chats, settings and .env survive updates. This build is unsigned.

releases.name: LLocalMind v0.3.0 - llama.cpp by default
releases.body:
LLocalMind 0.3.0 - llama.cpp by default.

- The desktop recommends and defaults to llama.cpp CPU for text and images. The original Intel native/OpenVINO engine remains an experimental option.
- Text-only use needs a GGUF and llama-server; mmproj is optional and is only required for image input. Text-only startup does not load the image projector/encoder.
- Web research works with both engines, including llama.cpp image conversations. Only question text is sent to Tavily; images stay local. Retrieved evidence uses the same untrusted-data and citation rules.
- Existing native configurations with a configured llama-server migrate once. Explicit experimental choices remain saved; setups without the runtime are retained until it is installed/selected. Models and chats are not deleted or moved.
- Component tests cover text-only transport, image rejection without mmproj, source/image preparation, search privacy, migration and settings. No new full-model speed or quality result is claimed.
- Tavily .env support, language/theme choices, image profiles and the resilient updater are retained.

Download the Setup EXE, or extract the entire portable ZIP. Models remain external. Existing chats, settings and .env survive updates. This build is unsigned.

releases.name: LLocalMind v0.2.9 - Resilient updater
releases.body:
LLocalMind 0.2.9 - Resilient updater.

- Update checks retry temporary GitHub failures with bounded waits and shorter metadata timeouts.
- If the releases API remains unavailable or rate-limited, the updater uses an official repository-hosted manifest. Both sources enforce the same version, asset URL, size and SHA-256 validation.
- If neither source is reachable, the app shows a clear retry message and an Open GitHub Releases button instead of reporting no updates.
- Cancellation stops retry backoff. Transient installer/checksum connection errors retry without weakening integrity checks or keeping partial installers.
- The official fallback manifest is generated after complete release uploads and refreshed at stable promotion. It excludes drafts and incomplete packages; public previews remain supported.
- Tavily .env support and local inference from 0.2.8 are retained. Existing chats, settings, models and the external .env are preserved.

If your current updater fails, download this Setup EXE directly and run it over the installed version. No uninstall is needed. This build is unsigned.

releases.name: LLocalMind v0.2.8 - Tavily API key
releases.body:
LLocalMind 0.2.8 - Tavily API key from .env.

- Web research now uses your personal Tavily API key from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\LLocalMind\.env`: `TAVILY_API_KEY=tvly-YOUR-KEY`. It replaces anonymous/keyless mode.
- The file is read on each search; no model restart is needed. UTF-8/BOM, quoted values, comments and an optional export prefix are supported. Keys are not stored in chats/settings or exported to local engines.
- Missing/invalid keys stop before network access. Authentication and quota errors are explicit, without leaking the key. Requests refuse redirects.
- One basic request per search, up to three sources, no remote AI answer, no automatic retries, no anonymous or advanced fallback.
- Choose Tavily Free and keep pay-as-you-go/automatic top-ups disabled. Billing is controlled by Tavily; the app cannot verify or disable paid account settings. Free quotas can change.
- README includes the PowerShell commands and setup instructions. Query text leaves the PC only when web research is selected; model answers stay local.
- Windows tests cover file parsing, authentication, error handling, source validation and GUI behavior. Real account/service availability still requires a user-key test.

Download the Setup EXE, or extract the entire portable ZIP. Models are external. Updates preserve chats, settings and the external .env. This build is unsigned.

releases.name: LLocalMind v0.2.7 - Free keyless web search
releases.body:
LLocalMind 0.2.7 - Free keyless web search.

- New searches use Tavily's documented keyless API rather than scraping DuckDuckGo result pages. No account, API key, remote answer generation or paid fallback is used.
- Only the current question is sent; up to three public HTTPS sources and bounded API excerpts are provided to the local model as untrusted evidence. Source pages are not fetched directly.
- Free anonymous usage has limits and may be unavailable. Limits stop the request; the app never reads TAVILY_API_KEY or activates a paid account.
- Existing chats retain their DuckDuckGo label. Regenerating a web answer uses Tavily and updates the attribution.
- Local contract tests cover keyless headers, no secret use, no paid fallback, malformed/limited responses, cancellation and source validation. Live availability still depends on the service and network and must be tested on the target PC.
- Detailed / Fast images and local inference are retained. Web search stays opt-in.

Download the Setup EXE, or extract the entire portable ZIP. Models are external. Updates preserve chats and settings. This build is unsigned.

releases.name: LLocalMind v0.2.6 - Web search fixes
releases.body:
LLocalMind 0.2.6 - Web search fixes.

- Read both DuckDuckGo HTML and Lite result layouts, including relative HTTPS links and encoded result redirects. Duplicate results are removed.
- Try the Lite interface when HTML returns no usable results. Explicit anti-bot/access/rate-limit blocks stop the search and show a specific error.
- Failed requests now keep a clear error and Regenerate action in the conversation, including after reopening. Error metadata is not sent to the model as an answer.
- A failed search does not silently fall back to an unverified model answer about current events.
- Web availability remains dependent on DuckDuckGo and the network; offline regression tests do not prove availability on the user's PC.
- Detailed / Fast image modes from 0.2.5 are retained.

Download the Setup EXE, or extract the entire portable ZIP. Models are external. Updates preserve existing chats and settings. This build is unsigned.

releases.name: LLocalMind v0.2.5 - Vision image modes
releases.body:
Vision image modes: Detailed / Fast.

- Switch image profiles directly in Vision mode without reloading the model.
- Fast limits image area to reduce visual work where supported; it preserves the whole scene and saved originals, but can lose small text and fine details. Detailed keeps previous behavior and remains the default.
- Diagnostics can alternate both profiles with prompt reuse disabled, reporting first-token and prefill timings. Actual Hermes/mmproj speed and quality gains still require target-PC measurement.
- Temporary official-runtime download failures have bounded retries; size, SHA-256 and executable checks remain mandatory.
- Windows source tests, the actual CPU vision runtime, packaged EXE, installer and installed app were verified in the successful build matching this tag. Artifacts were recovered from that exact build and their checksums checked again before publication.

Download the Setup EXE, or extract the entire portable ZIP. Models are external. Existing chats and settings are preserved when updating. This build is unsigned.

releases.name: LLocalMind v0.2.3 - Italian Interface
releases.body:
LLocalMind 0.2.3 - Italian Interface.

- Optional Italian Interface sidebar switch: azure theme, thin tricolour top bar and thick tricolour user-bubble borders with solid light-blue interiors.
- Large Dottore, parti 🍕 / Fratello, fermati 🍝 controls retain normal send/stop behavior. Appearance is saved separately and never changes language, prompts or the loaded model.

- Italian/English interface, a separate Language sidebar button and the same selector in Settings. The choice persists without reloading the model.
- English mode guides new text/vision answers in English unless another language is explicitly requested; saved conversations are not translated. CLI: --language en.
- Web research remains experimental and may fail or return incomplete results. Text prefill is generally negligible in recent local use; image prefill is still being measured for more precise figures.

- Installer: download `LLocalMind-Setup-*-windows-x64.exe`.
- Portable: extract the whole portable ZIP, then open `LLocalMind/LLocalMind.exe`.

- Each generated answer shows its token count and measured decode speed; these metrics are saved with conversations.
- Stable v0.1.10 gives more complete answers by default and raises the maximum response length from 128 to 512 tokens.
- v0.2.0 adds opt-in DuckDuckGo research: up to three public HTTPS pages are excerpted for the local text model. The query and page requests leave the PC; web text is treated as untrusted input.
- The v0.1.9 CPU-only vision path is retained; both the vision encoder and language model run on CPU.
- The packaged vision runtime is pinned to the official Windows CPU build. Advanced visual-token settings are unchanged; real-model image quality and CPU performance still require target-PC validation.
- New: bounded visual-token/batch/cache defaults, image/prefix reuse, lazy vision imports and engine-specific reloads. Advanced settings expose the speed/detail tradeoff.
- New: native long-prompt shared-expert batching, reusable KV storage and coalesced GUI streaming.
- New: local load/request reports and `LLocalMind-Diagnostics.exe --benchmark-vision --image PATH` (close the GUI first). No target-PC vision speed is claimed.
- Settings → Installa / aggiorna motore vision CPU downloads, verifies and configures the official Windows CPU llama.cpp runtime automatically, without administrator rights.
- The updater now includes public preview releases, selects the highest newer numeric version, and continues to exclude drafts and verify installer SHA-256. Older stable-only apps need this preview installer run manually once.
- The runtime is pinned to b12110 with a verified SHA-256; cancellation cleans temporary files and existing installations are preserved.
- New: local image attachments in the GUI and CLI, with persistent image history and a local llama.cpp vision engine.
